name: STICKEE | Tangie | 1G | Live Resin Concentrate
description: ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ ". . . basically Red Bull, but legal and less jittery.” Tangie is citrus with a megaphone. We engineered it by capturing the soul of an orange that once dated a tangerine, distilling the zest into live resin so punchy it basically writes its own rave flyer. One dab and your mouth is a citrus festival with bass drops and glow sticks. This sativa is more refreshing than a cold shower after bad decisions. The science? A terpene cocktail dominated by limonene, which is basically sunshine in molecular form. That’s why your brain gets blasted with creativity, energy, and the sudden need to text everyone about your new business idea. Buy it because vitamins are overrated—this is citrus for adults.
